title: Instructional Design Specialist
description:
Instructional Design Specialist
San Antonio, TX (Remote)
12-Month Contract
Job ID 25-09803

Solugenix is assisting a client, a prestigious and large investment management company in their search for an Instructional Design Specialist. This is a 12-month contract opportunity based out of San Antonio, TX (Remote).

This is a production-based role. The appropriate candidate will manage their own work under the direction of a project lead. Samples of past work via portfolio and/or personal website, are appreciated. The Position will focus on approximately 90% design and development. Candidates will work with Project Leads & client's SMEs to design/create/develop training from inception to execution for American Funds Service Groups (AFSG) client services-based departments.

Qualifications:

  • In-depth knowledge of instructional design skills (focused on design and development) and adult learning theories.
  • Ability to prioritize work and complete in a timely manner.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.
  • Strong detail orientation, organization, time management, and multi-tasking.
  • Learning agility, as required for work assignments.
  • Ability to collaborate and work effectively as part of local or remote teams.
  • Identifies areas for improvement within client training processes and/or technologies and makes recommendations for solutions.
Must Haves:
  • As part of the ADDIE model: Implementation, and Evaluation
  • Articulate 360 - Storyline and Rise
  • Camtasia
  • Video development/editing
  • As part of the ADDIE model: Design and Development
  • Ability to develop in various modalities: ILT/VILT, eLearning, self-paced, & virtual classroom
  • Strong Microsoft Office 365 Suite (e.g., PowerPoint, Word, Excel, etc.)
  • Intermediate MS SharePoint Online experience (load, check-in, check out documents)
Nice to Have:
  • Captivate
  • Adobe Audition, Illustrator, and Photoshop
  • NovoEd Learning Platform
  • Graphic design
  • Experience recording and editing audio
  • As part of the ADDIE model: Analysis, Implementation, and Evaluation
  • Assessment/Test design and development

Pay Range for CA, CO, IL, NJ, NY, WA, and DC: $48.28/hour to $48.28/hour. Starting rate of pay offered may vary depending on factors including but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience.

Solugenix will consider qualified applicants with a criminal history pursuant to the California Fair Chance Act and Ordinance. Applicants do not need to disclose their criminal history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if we are concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, applicants will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.
